question: Which run of the Box-Behnken design gave the lowest decolorization efficiency, and under what conditions?
rendered: According to the text, the lowest response (decolorization efficiency) occurred at run 1, with conditions of pH 6.5, an initial dye concentration of 70 mg L−1, and a monolith dosage of 0.75 g, resulting in a decolorization efficiency of 60.34%.
